channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerability landscape reveals a high volume of critical threats targeting enterprise infrastructure, with extensive coverage across desktop operating systems, cloud environments, and industrial control networks. Microsoft ecosystems face severe scrutiny due to numerous remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws in Windows protocols, Office applications, Azure services, and SQL Server, alongside significant risks in IoT devices, database middleware, and web platforms stemming from buffer overflows, authentication bypasses, and command injections. These vulnerabilities collectively endanger core network operations, software supply chains, and physical safety by enabling unauthenticated access, lateral movement, and system compromise across diverse hardware and software stacks.
